title: Deep learning identifies MYT1L as a regulator that restricts glioblastoma plasticity
summary: scDORI inferred enhancer-linked regulatory networks from single-cell multiome data and prioritized regulators for perturbation. MYT1L overexpression restricted alternative cell states and reduced tumor growth and invasion in mice; loss of MYT1L restored malignant features. This is preclinical evidence, not an established treatment. The result was public in a May 13, 2025 preprint; the peer-reviewed paper appeared November 4, 2026.
ai_technology: scDORI; deep learning for enhancer-linked gene-regulatory network inference
organization: German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ); European Molecular Biology Laboratory (EMBL); Wellcome Sanger Institute

evidence.tested: Patient-derived cell perturbations and mouse xenograft experiments tested inferred regulators.
evidence.unknown: Clinical benefit and independent follow-up replication were not established by this review.
evidence.ai_role: Deep network inference nominated regulatory programs and MYT1L for experimental testing.
